raw_response: {"diagnosis": "83 EUR-denominated transactions are summed unconverted into silver_transactions.amount, which is documented as USD. raw_fx_rates gives EUR rate_to_usd = 1.25, so silver should convert amount to USD at that rate, and the gold tables inherit the fix.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.5, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount * f.rate_to_usd AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON f.currency = t.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED';"}}
